description: Durable journalism and crime-procedure words for the Lin An urban-fantasy crime series.

words.example_zh_tok: 林安 采访 证人 。
words.example_en: Lin An interviews a witness.
words.story_affordance: Lets Lin An extract information actively instead of only asking and listening.
words.difficulty_note: Common news verb; repeat in witness scenes.
words.notes: Core journalist action for the series.

words.example_zh_tok: 这 个 报道 让 大家 害怕 。
words.example_en: This report makes everyone afraid.
words.story_affordance: Turns investigation into public pressure.
words.difficulty_note: Useful as both noun and verb; keep context simple.
words.notes: Good for newsroom and aftermath scenes.

words.example_zh_tok: 老 报纸 里面 有 线索 。
words.example_en: There is a clue in the old newspaper.
words.story_affordance: Makes old evidence physical and searchable.
words.difficulty_note: Concrete object; easy to repeat.
words.notes: Useful for archives and memory clues.

words.example_zh_tok: 林安 写 文章 。
words.example_en: Lin An writes an article.
words.story_affordance: Lets reporting become an action with consequences.
words.difficulty_note: High-utility modern word.
words.notes: Use for drafts, publication, and pressure.

words.example_zh_tok: 编辑 不 想 发布 文章 。
words.example_en: The editor does not want to publish the article.
words.story_affordance: Adds newsroom pressure and a superior who can block or protect Lin An.
words.difficulty_note: Can be person or action; prefer person first.

words.example_zh_tok: 标题 看上去 很 奇怪 。
words.example_en: The headline looks strange.
words.story_affordance: Makes public-facing stakes concrete.
words.difficulty_note: Best repeated around articles or websites.

words.example_zh_tok: 这个 消息 的 来源 不 清楚 。
words.example_zh_natural: 这个消息的来源不清楚。
words.example_en: The source of this message is not clear.
words.story_affordance: Lets evidence and tips have reliability problems.
words.difficulty_note: Abstract but very useful; repeat with messages and files.

words.example_zh_tok: 读者 想 知道 真相 。
words.example_en: Readers want to know the truth.
words.story_affordance: Adds social consequence to reporting.
words.difficulty_note: Useful but should not replace concrete characters.

words.example_zh_tok: 媒体 都 在 谈 这个 案件 。
words.example_en: The media are all talking about this case.
words.story_affordance: Creates public pressure around a case.
words.difficulty_note: Keep use concrete to avoid abstract exposition.

words.example_zh_tok: 网站 上 有 一 张 照片 。
words.example_en: There is a photo on the website.
words.story_affordance: Gives modern publication and clue discovery a place.
words.difficulty_note: Concrete modern noun.
words.notes: Useful for public clues and false leads.

words.example_zh_tok: 林安 不 能 发布 这 个 消息 。
words.example_zh_natural: 林安不能发布这个消息。
words.example_en: Lin An cannot release this message.
words.story_affordance: Creates publish-or-protect decisions.
words.difficulty_note: Use with messages, articles, websites.

words.example_zh_tok: 她 想 发表 这 篇 文章 。
words.example_en: She wants to publish this article.
words.story_affordance: Gives article writing a formal endpoint.
words.difficulty_note: Close to 发布; contrast gradually.

words.example_zh_tok: 线人 透露 一个 秘密 。
words.example_en: The informant reveals a secret.
words.story_affordance: Allows partial leaks and source scenes.
words.difficulty_note: Pair with source and secret.

words.example_zh_tok: 她 收到 一 封 邮件 。
words.example_en: She receives an email.
words.story_affordance: Creates a modern clue object.
words.difficulty_note: Use with 收到 and 打开.

words.example_zh_tok: 这个 文件 不能 公开 。
words.example_en: This file cannot be made public.
words.story_affordance: Creates reveal-or-hide stakes.
words.difficulty_note: Use as verb first.

words.example_zh_tok: 文件 里面 有 证据 。
words.example_en: There is evidence inside the file.
words.story_affordance: Makes evidence concrete and portable.
words.difficulty_note: High utility; repeat in investigation scenes.

words.example_zh_tok: 林安 找到 新 资料 。
words.example_en: Lin An finds new materials.
words.story_affordance: Broadens clues beyond evidence.
words.difficulty_note: Slightly abstract; keep attached to files or cases.

words.example_zh_tok: 老 档案 还 在 办公室 。
words.example_en: The old archive is still in the office.
words.story_affordance: Supports old cases and hidden records.
words.difficulty_note: Use with old cases and offices.

words.example_zh_tok: 录音 里 有 一个 声音 。
words.example_en: There is a voice in the recording.
words.story_affordance: Lets voice evidence contradict testimony.
words.difficulty_note: Concrete clue; repeat with 听.

words.example_zh_tok: 录像 让 警方 改变 想法 。
words.example_en: The video makes the police change their view.
words.story_affordance: Adds visual evidence and misdirection.
words.difficulty_note: Use with 看 and 摄像机.

words.example_zh_tok: 镜头 后面 有 黑 影 。
words.example_en: There is a dark shadow behind the lens.
words.story_affordance: Supports photo/video misdirection.
words.difficulty_note: Use sparingly with cameras.

words.example_zh_tok: 门口 的 摄像机 坏 了 。
words.example_en: The camera at the doorway is broken.
words.story_affordance: Creates surveillance clues and gaps.
words.difficulty_note: Three-character technical noun; repeat if introduced.

words.example_zh_tok: 林安 给 文件 拍照 。
words.example_en: Lin An takes a photo of the file.
words.story_affordance: Lets the protagonist gather evidence actively.
words.difficulty_note: Natural modern action.

words.example_zh_tok: 密码 打开 了 那 个 文件 。
words.example_en: The password opens that file.
words.story_affordance: Works for phones, files, doors, and fantasy locks.
words.difficulty_note: High utility; repeat with 打开.

words.example_zh_tok: 这是 机密 资料 。
words.example_en: This is confidential material.
words.story_affordance: Raises stakes around files and sources.
words.difficulty_note: Use mostly as adjective before 资料 or 文件.

words.example_zh_tok: 这个 案件 还 没有 结束 。
words.example_en: This case is not over yet.
words.story_affordance: Lets narration name the crime plot cleanly.
words.difficulty_note: Formal but common; repeat throughout.

words.example_zh_tok: 嫌犯 否认 了 一切 。
words.example_en: The suspect denied everything.
words.story_affordance: Creates a reusable crime-role label.
words.difficulty_note: Important crime noun; repeat with 否认.

words.example_zh_tok: 证人 不 愿意 说话 。
words.example_en: The witness is not willing to talk.
words.story_affordance: Turns interviews into crime scenes with risk.
words.difficulty_note: High-utility crime word.

words.example_zh_tok: 证词 和 录音 不 一样 。
words.example_en: The testimony and the recording are different.
words.story_affordance: Lets spoken accounts become evidence.
words.difficulty_note: Pair with witness and recording.

words.example_zh_tok: 受害人 的 家人 想 要 真相 。
words.example_zh_natural: 受害人的家人想要真相。
words.example_en: The victim's family wants the truth.
words.story_affordance: Keeps emotional stakes attached to the case.
words.difficulty_note: Three-character word; repeat gently.

words.example_zh_tok: 这个 嫌犯 有 动机 吗 ？
words.example_en: Does this suspect have a motive?
words.story_affordance: Lets characters reason about why someone acted.
words.difficulty_note: Abstract crime word; repeat in simple questions.

words.example_zh_tok: 警方 没有 找到 凶器 。
words.example_en: The police did not find the weapon.
words.story_affordance: Adds concrete crime clues.
words.difficulty_note: Use only when a violent case needs it.
words.notes: Can be too heavy for gentle stories.

words.example_zh_tok: 警方 正在 调查 案件 。
words.example_en: The police are investigating the case.
words.story_affordance: Refers to police institutionally without naming one officer.
words.difficulty_note: Use for public/news style narration.

words.example_zh_tok: 林安 去 警察局 找 陈雨 。
words.example_en: Lin An goes to the police station to find Chen Yu.
words.story_affordance: Adds a recurring procedural location.
words.difficulty_note: Concrete location; good repetition target.

words.example_zh_tok: 邻居 想 报警 。
words.example_en: The neighbor wants to call the police.
words.story_affordance: Lets ordinary people start or escalate a case.
words.difficulty_note: Common action; repeat in danger scenes.

words.example_zh_tok: 警方 搜查 老 房子 。
words.example_en: The police search the old house.
words.story_affordance: Adds procedural action beyond generic finding.
words.difficulty_note: More formal than 搜索; use with places.

words.example_zh_tok: 林安 在 网站 上 搜索 名字 。
words.example_zh_natural: 林安在网站上搜索名字。
words.example_en: Lin An searches the name on the website.
words.story_affordance: Supports phone, website, and archive investigation.
words.difficulty_note: Use with digital or broad searching.

words.example_zh_tok: 有人 跟踪 林安 。
words.example_en: Someone follows Lin An.
words.story_affordance: Creates urban suspense and danger.
words.difficulty_note: Strong action verb; repeat carefully.

words.example_zh_tok: 陈雨 追踪 这个 号码 。
words.example_en: Chen Yu traces this number.
words.story_affordance: Lets investigators follow clues over time.
words.difficulty_note: Close to 跟踪; use for clues or numbers.

words.example_zh_tok: 林安 观察 房间 里 的 痕迹 。
words.example_zh_natural: 林安观察房间里的痕迹。
words.example_en: Lin An observes the traces in the room.
words.story_affordance: Makes Lin An feel professionally perceptive.
words.difficulty_note: Use with visible details.

words.example_zh_tok: 他们 一直 监视 那 个 门口 。
words.example_zh_natural: 他们一直监视那个门口。
words.example_en: They keep watching that doorway.
words.story_affordance: Adds antagonist or police pressure.
words.difficulty_note: Use with danger or suspicion.

words.example_zh_tok: 杯 上 有 指纹 。
words.example_en: There is a fingerprint on the cup.
words.story_affordance: Adds a precise physical clue.
words.difficulty_note: Concrete but specific; repeat if used.

words.example_zh_tok: 地 上 没有 血迹 。
words.example_en: There is no bloodstain on the ground.
words.story_affordance: Makes physical crime clues precise.
words.difficulty_note: Use only when tone allows violence.
words.notes: Can be strong for easy readers.

words.example_zh_tok: 门 上 有 奇怪 的 痕迹 。
words.example_en: There is a strange mark on the door.
words.story_affordance: General clue word for physical and fantasy evidence.
words.difficulty_note: Very useful; repeat across locations.

words.example_zh_tok: 线人 只 愿意 晚上 见面 。
words.example_en: The informant is only willing to meet at night.
words.story_affordance: Gives Lin An a source with danger and limits.
words.difficulty_note: Important role word; define through action.

words.example_zh_tok: 林安 不能 马上 判断 。
words.example_en: Lin An cannot judge immediately.
words.story_affordance: Helps reasoning scenes without complex language.
words.difficulty_note: Abstract but useful; keep sentences short.

words.example_zh_tok: 陈雨 确认 了 文件 的 来源 。
words.example_zh_natural: 陈雨确认了文件的来源。
words.example_en: Chen Yu confirms the source of the file.
words.story_affordance: Lets clues become reliable.
words.difficulty_note: High utility in investigation scenes.

words.example_zh_tok: 嫌犯 否认 认识 受害人 。
words.example_en: The suspect denies knowing the victim.
words.story_affordance: Gives suspect interviews tension.
words.difficulty_note: Pair with 嫌犯 and 证据.

words.example_zh_tok: 林安 必须 为 线人 保密 。
words.example_en: Lin An must keep the informant secret.
words.story_affordance: Creates source-protection and ethical tension.
words.difficulty_note: Use with source and identity protection.

words.example_zh_tok: 有人 举报 了 这个 公司 。
words.example_en: Someone reported this company.
words.story_affordance: Lets ordinary people trigger an investigation.
words.difficulty_note: Use with companies, police, or media.
